title: This is Reverend Blackstar to Ground Control...

posts.author: Reverend_Blackstar
posts.body:
Hi, everybody! As you may have guessed from the message title, I'm a huge Bowie fan. I'm also an OG gamer who can remember the arcade cabinets and Atari 2600. But I've wanted to make games for a while now. Even made the expensive mistake of going to the Art Institute of Pittsburgh for it (total diploma mill that taught me nothing of what they promised).
I've tried making stabs with other game engines on my own but they all were uncooperative with me. RPG Maker MV is the first one that's been a joy to work with. Now I feel like I can get some of the ideas out of my head and onto the screen at last.
But since I'm a total noob at this, I would appreciate any and all advice. Look forward to hearing from you all...thanks for listening!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum!
I am a few years older than you and I just started using RPG Maker MZ about 3 years ago with no prior experience.
RPG Maker is a great way to get started. My best advice is to search YouTube for tutorial series for MV. There are plenty of them out there.
Recreate the tutorials in your own test project so you can learn how to do the basics. Then is it about exploring the engine, looking at the help files, and experimenting.
Of course there is also the built in tutorial for MV.
Just start test projects that allow you to explore what interests you. Then you could try making a very small game to learn the end to end process.
Learning to use some scripts is also incredibly helpful.
Do what makes you happy and ask questions when you need to. But often you can find an answer by searching the internet.
Good luck on your projects!
